correctness.rationale: Verified all 4^10=1048576 input states independently by stdlib path-marking and C++ indegree peeling; complete exact functional-graph lemma, local rule and labelled encoding specified. Both give only orbit periods 1,4,5 with primitive counts 1,530,6 and identical full 25-cell entry-period matrix. C++ evaluates F^28=F^8 on every state and finds exactly 20 inputs where F^27!=F^7. Python exhaustively partitions every temporal orbit under all 20 graph automorphisms, gives 11 size-ten and 21 size-twenty four-cycle classes, and two/four five-cycle classes with basin weights 1280/7355. It also proves all 20 maximally delayed states form one symmetry orbit. Programs and independent output files are embedded, replayed, and referenced. No extrapolation to infinite families.

value.rationale: The 5-rung pentagonal prism is a canonical sparse cyclic network previously studied for three-color excitation and directly comparable to four-color Petersen dynamics. A fourth refractory stage produces distinct exact recurrence and attraction geometry: two temporal-five-wave symmetry families have individual attraction basins 1280 versus 7355, despite identical least period, and all 20 slowest states lie in one spatial orbit. The complete first-entry-time/period census and strict eight-step cutoff provide a natural finite benchmark for wave selection and graph topology. The contribution is not the already-covered generic existence of five-waves or a routine recomputation of a known table.
